items.title: Bruce Johnstone interviewed by Monk Rowe, Dunkirk, New York, October 11, 2013
items.q: I had started a fusion group called New York Mary, along with Rick Petrone and Joe Corsello.

ctx.x: It was a bit like being your bodyguard.

Yeah. So that was unnerving. And also I had started a fusion group called New York Mary, along with Rick Petrone and Joe Corsello. And we had two albums for Arista. And they did rather well. They were both “Hit Pick of the Month” in “Billboard” and “Cash Box,” and usually when they do that they say, you know, best track is — they listed all the tracks on both albums. So the second album Arista sent out in a plain cover, just as a promo. And it was getting airplay like crazy on all the black radio stations from…
You mean they were playing it but they didn’t know that you were an all white band.
